actions.name: command
actions.description: Run a shell command from the project root.

actions.name: wait
actions.description: Base wait action.

actions.name: assert_file
actions.description: Assert that a project file exists and optionally contains text.

actions.name: assert_json
actions.description: Assert a JSON file value with a JSONPath-style selector.

actions.name: assert_exit_code
actions.description: Assert the exit code captured from a command node output.

actions.name: assert_output
actions.description: Assert a previous node's stdout/stderr with contains or match, or compare a structured output field using assert.path and an operator such as eq or length_eq.

actions.name: watch_logs
actions.description: Base log assertion/capture action.

actions.name: index_artifacts
actions.description: Index extra recipe-authored artifacts that already exist on disk. Do not use after ui.screenshot; screenshots are registered by the runner.

actions.name: end
actions.description: Base terminal action.

actions.name: call
actions.description: Invoke a named recipe by ref and run its steps inline.

actions.name: switch
actions.description: Choose a graph branch when one resolved string equals another.

actions.name: ui.navigate
actions.description: Navigate by semantic page intent when available; the adapter uses the current visible UI or a verified route. Raw url/hash/path values must be verified against the current app first. Perps Home returns gate=perps-tutorial and gateSelector without dismissing a visible tutorial. Complete explicit tutorial setup before dependent market or activity navigation.

actions.name: ui.press
actions.description: Press/tap/click a UI target through the platform adapter.

actions.name: ui.key_press
actions.description: Send a trusted keyboard press to the currently focused UI element through the UI transport.

actions.name: ui.set_input
actions.description: Set text on an extension DOM input through the CDP UI transport.

actions.name: ui.scroll
actions.description: Scroll through the UI through the Farmslot base platform adapter. Supports deltas and scroll_into_view for selector/test-id proof positioning.

actions.name: ui.swipe
actions.description: Swipe from a test-id target or screen coordinates in one cardinal direction through the shared browser UI transport.

actions.name: ui.pan
actions.description: Pan from a test-id target or screen coordinates through the shared browser UI transport. path and delta are offsets from the resolved start, not absolute endpoints.

actions.name: ui.drag
actions.description: Drag a test-id target or screen coordinate through the shared browser UI transport. path and delta are offsets from the resolved start, not absolute endpoints.

actions.name: ui.long_press
actions.description: Hold a test-id target or screen coordinate through the shared browser UI transport.

actions.name: ui.wait_for
actions.description: Wait for a UI condition through the Extension CDP adapter.

actions.name: ui.screenshot
actions.description: Capture the current native browser window on macOS, with bounded Chrome viewport capture as fallback. A native window can include a separate side panel or a tab other than the driven page. For report evidence of the driven document, use ui.capture_surface. Always inspect the resulting PNG and artifact metadata; failed real capture does not produce a reconstructed DOM image.

actions.name: ui.capture_surface
actions.description: Capture the complete current browser document through Chrome as one registered PNG. Includes document content below the viewport, not browser chrome or the hidden contents of nested scroll areas. Keep viewport assertions separate.

actions.name: app.status
actions.description: Report the adapter's static status — platform, project root, resolved checkout shape, and headless compatibility mode (no live route or account).

actions.name: app.hud
actions.description: Display minimal human-readable recipe progress. The intent must explain the current agent goal; debug metadata and grouping labels are hidden unless explicitly opted in.

actions.name: cdp.target
actions.description: Probe the platform debug transport — Chrome CDP for extension, the React Native debug bridge for mobile — and report whether it is reachable.

actions.name: metamask.perps.ensure_unwatchlisted
actions.description: Idempotently restore the visible Extension Perps market to an unwatchlisted state during workflow teardown.

actions.name: metamask.feature_flags.set
actions.description: Report that the extension cannot pin remote feature flags at runtime and name the relaunch that can. The extension pins flags into the per-run dist snapshot manifest at launch.

actions.name: metamask.feature_flags.read
actions.description: Read the effective remote feature flags, the manifest pin, and the fetched flags from the running extension.

actions.name: metamask.feature_flags.clear
actions.description: Confirm no manifest flag pin is active, or name the relaunch that drops it.

actions.name: ui.locators
actions.description: List ranked, copy-pasteable ui.press targets from the current ui.visible observation. Prefer high-confidence test IDs when updating durable recipe source after exploratory interaction.

actions.name: app.network_capture
actions.description: Capture redacted HTTP requests between named Recipe Protocol v1 nodes through the adapter's persistent Network observer.

actions.name: metamask.app.assert_no_console_errors
actions.description: Fail when MetaMask (service worker or UI pages) logged an error or uncaught exception that no console allowlist (the bundled library's, then each recipe library's diagnostics/console-allowlist.json) marks as known noise, judging the events since the launch began, by their own timestamps. Reads extension-console.log from the offset mm-harness launch records when it starts, and leaves out records the collector stamps with an event time before the launch (a replaced collector's replay of a browser the launch kept); with no recorded launch it fails unless since is start-of-log. The same classification feeds run diagnostics. Fails as unavailable unless this runtime's console collector runs on the run's CDP port and a control line logged in MetaMask's service worker or page reaches extension-console.log. Allowlist entries are exact signatures (schemaVersion 3).

actions.name: app.network_assert
actions.description: Assert a previously indexed app.network_capture summary without hiding its diagnostics on failure.

actions.name: app.performance_capture
actions.description: Capture bounded CDP renderer frame metrics and separately labelled JavaScript work across Recipe Protocol v1 node boundaries.

actions.name: app.performance_assert
actions.description: Assert a previously indexed app.performance_capture summary without hiding unavailable or partial source coverage.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.fixture_status
actions.description: Report the on-disk wallet fixture status (accounts and password presence) without launching or mutating the app.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.validate_import
actions.description: Validate wallet recovery credentials and derive the expected primary address without launching or mutating the app.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.setup
actions.description: Import the wallet fixture accounts and password so the app starts from a known signed-in state.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.import
actions.description: Make the wallet ready through visible onboarding or prove and select the derived account in an existing visible session when method=ui.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.reset
actions.description: Delete the current wallet through the visible client reset flow and reach fresh onboarding.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.ensure_unlocked
actions.description: Unlock the wallet with the fixture password when it is currently locked.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.select_account
actions.description: extension action to select a wallet account by address, id, or display name.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.list_accounts
actions.description: List redacted wallet accounts and identify the selected account without mutating the app.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.read_state
actions.description: Read redacted wallet state, or pending approval IDs/types/count from the source-dev store without modifying requests. Pending approvals are unsupported on official artifacts without the dev store.

actions.name: metamask.performance.measure_navigation_memory
actions.description: Measure retained DOM nodes and listeners across repeated Extension navigation after forced garbage collection, using least-squares slopes and separate declared bounds.

actions.name: metamask.performance.measure_detached_dom
actions.description: Compare retained detached-DOM counts before and after repeated Extension navigation, with forced garbage collection before each heap snapshot.

actions.name: metamask.performance.compare_idle_navigation_memory
actions.description: Compare equal-duration idle and navigating Extension arms to isolate navigation-attributable listener growth after forced garbage collection.

actions.name: metamask.assets.read_visible_state
actions.description: Read and assert bounded visible wallet assets from an untouched Extension runtime without product background hooks.

actions.name: metamask.assets.open_details
actions.description: Open the uniquely visible Extension asset matching a symbol; refuse ambiguous rows without clicking. Symbol alone does not prove funding or network identity.

actions.name: metamask.assets.read_details
actions.description: Observe asset details until requested chart and market data are ready within the polling budget. A required chart needs visible price labels and an unmuted price, not just a canvas. Never refreshes the page.

actions.name: metamask.assets.verify_sorting
actions.description: Verify both Extension asset sort modes and restore the observed initial preference after success or failure. Already-selected modes skip redundant selection; row-order observation is bounded.

actions.name: metamask.assets.set_token_visibility
actions.description: Enable or disable one uniquely matched Extension token through Manage tokens and verify the home list state. Ambiguous search results fail before toggling; require_unchanged verifies existing visibility without repairing it.

actions.name: metamask.wallet.lock
actions.description: Lock the Extension wallet through the visible global menu and prove the unlock page appears.

actions.name: metamask.assets.import_custom_token
actions.description: Import one ERC-20 on a selected Extension network through the custom-token form and verify its row.

actions.name: metamask.assets.prepare_send
actions.description: Prepare a wallet-initiated EVM asset send through visible UI without advancing to confirmation.

actions.name: metamask.assets.review_send
actions.description: Advance a prepared Extension send to confirmation and prove its visible network fee.

actions.name: metamask.assets.set_custom_gas
actions.description: Set a custom EVM gas limit on the current Extension send confirmation through visible controls.

actions.name: metamask.assets.select_network_scope
actions.description: Select the all-networks Extension asset scope through the visible network filter.

actions.name: metamask.networks.read_visible_state
actions.description: Read one selected Extension network and prove its visible balance rows remain stable across a bounded settle window.

actions.name: metamask.networks.add_custom
actions.description: Add or select one custom Extension network through visible network management controls.

actions.name: metamask.networks.add_chainlist
actions.description: Add or select one Extension network from the visible ChainList search results.

actions.name: metamask.networks.remove_custom
actions.description: Remove one custom Extension network through visible network management controls.

actions.name: metamask.swap_bridge.read_visible_state
actions.description: Read the visible Swap surface without mutation. require_quote additionally needs exposed bridge quote state to verify current input/quote identity; surface-only reads do not require those hooks.

actions.name: metamask.swap_bridge.select_assets
actions.description: Select exact Swap source and destination assets through the visible asset pickers.

actions.name: metamask.swap_bridge.set_amount
actions.description: Enter a positive Swap amount through visible UI. Quote waiting requires exposed bridge quote state to bind the current token-unit amount and assets to the quote; no implicit refresh or submission.

actions.name: metamask.swap_bridge.set_slippage
actions.description: Set a custom Swap slippage percentage through the visible transaction settings.

actions.name: metamask.swap_bridge.set_max_amount
actions.description: Use the visible Swap Max control; quote waiting requires exposed bridge quote state and a reviewable quote matching current inputs. Never refresh or submit implicitly.

actions.name: metamask.perps.read_visible_state
actions.description: Read and assert bounded visible Perps UI state without product background hooks. marketDetails exposes visible symbol, pair, name, price and priceChange as text, or null when absent/ambiguous. marketCount counts the bounded observed markets array, not an unbounded total. topMovers separately reports its bounded pills, count and visibleCount when that list is observed; otherwise null. favorite is boolean only when the requested market pair and one favorite control are both visible; otherwise null, never an assumed false.

actions.name: metamask.perps.search_markets
actions.description: Enter a Perps market query through the visible search field and prove visible results are returned.

actions.name: metamask.perps.select_market_filter
actions.description: Select and assert a live Perps market category through trusted visible UI controls.

actions.name: metamask.perps.close_visible_position
actions.description: Close all or part of one live Perps position through semantic visible controls.

actions.name: metamask.perps.compare_provider_market
actions.description: Compare one visible Perps market with the live Hyperliquid production response.

actions.name: metamask.perps.read_eligibility
actions.description: Read the current Extension Perps eligibility and live MetaMask geolocation without changing either.

actions.name: metamask.perps.set_market_favorite
actions.description: Converge one live Perps market favorite to the requested state through its semantic visible control.

actions.name: metamask.perps.select_activity_filter
actions.description: Select and read one live Perps activity category through semantic visible controls.

actions.name: metamask.perps.open_balance_action
actions.description: Open Add funds or Withdraw from the live Perps balance dropdown in one trusted UI session.

actions.name: metamask.perps.open_position_action
actions.description: Open a position-management flow from a live Perps position through visible controls in one trusted UI session.

actions.name: metamask.perps.edit_margin
actions.description: Add or remove isolated margin from a live Perps position through visible controls and prove the reconciled position values.

actions.name: metamask.perps.update_position_tpsl
actions.description: Update take-profit and stop-loss for a live Extension Perps position through visible controls and prove the reconciled position row.

actions.name: metamask.settings.set_basic_functionality
actions.description: Converge the Extension Basic Functionality privacy setting through its visible toggle and confirmation modal.

actions.name: metamask.perps.read_funds_confirmation
actions.description: Read the loaded Perps deposit or withdraw confirmation without submitting it.

actions.name: metamask.perps.assert_visible_consistency
actions.description: Assert bounded rendered Perps market or price changes, or recent-to-full activity containment, through visible Extension UI.

actions.name: metamask.perps.read_snapshot
actions.description: Read a bounded, redacted source-dev snapshot of Extension Perps state through the optional product background hook.

actions.name: metamask.perps.read_positions
actions.description: extension Read live Perps positions; without a selector, return all live positions.

actions.name: metamask.perps.read_orders
actions.description: extension Read live Perps open orders; without a selector, return all live orders.

actions.name: metamask.perps.close_orders
actions.description: extension Default to testnet for Perps mutations; mainnet is read-only unless explicitly requested. Cancel selected live Perps open orders. Use selector/mode params to cancel matching symbols or all orders. Extension ensure_* only assert existing state; converge an owned testnet account through an explicitly funded leaf action. Mainnet is never mutated.

actions.name: metamask.perps.place_order
actions.description: extension Place a Perps order through a supported app/API path. Default to testnet; mainnet order placement requires an explicit user request.

actions.name: metamask.perps.assert_positions
actions.description: extension Assert live Perps positions are present or absent for an explicit market selection or mode=all.

actions.name: metamask.perps.assert_orders
actions.description: extension Assert live Perps open orders are present or absent for an explicit market selection or mode=all.

actions.name: metamask.perps.ensure_positions
actions.description: Read and assert the selected Extension Perps position state without creating or closing a position. Use an explicitly funded leaf action for any transition. Extension ensure_* only assert existing state; converge an owned testnet account through an explicitly funded leaf action. Mainnet is never mutated.

actions.name: metamask.perps.ensure_orders
actions.description: Read and assert the selected Extension Perps order state without creating or canceling an order. Use an explicitly funded leaf action for any transition. Extension ensure_* only assert existing state; converge an owned testnet account through an explicitly funded leaf action. Mainnet is never mutated.

actions.name: metamask.perps.teardown_state
actions.description: Verify an optional expected network, assert the requested final Extension Perps order and position state, then optionally navigate. This action never switches networks, closes positions or cancels orders.

actions.name: metamask.deeplink.open
actions.description: Open an HTTPS deeplink through real browser ingress so the Extension owns parsing, verification, and destination navigation.

actions.name: metamask.analytics.start_capture
actions.description: extension Start capturing MetaMetrics events at the Segment transport and return a cursor to bracket later reads.

actions.name: metamask.analytics.read_events
actions.description: extension Read MetaMetrics events captured since a cursor, as [{ event, properties, ts }].

actions.name: metamask.analytics.assert_events
actions.description: extension Assert MetaMetrics event names, property values and counts. Counts are the point: an exact count catches a double emit that a presence check cannot.

actions.name: metamask.analytics.set_consent
actions.description: extension Set MetaMetrics consent flags so events actually reach the Segment transport. Wallet fixtures set neither, so capture yields nothing without this.
